trust_decision.summary: Integer digit length must be validated every time the non-blocking parser suspends mid-number, not only when the number completes: each of the four suspension exits writes the accumulated digits into the TextBuffer and returns NOT_AVAILABLE, and only _setIntLength -> StreamReadConstraints.validateIntegerLength can stop the growth.

landing_point.why: The summary names 'async parser' + 'chunked digit accumulation', so an engineer lands on _finishNumberIntegralPart, the loop that appends resumed integer digits and suspends via MINOR_NUMBER_INTEGER_DIGITS.

fix_sites.entry_point: JsonFactory.createNonBlockingByteArrayParser()/createNonBlockingByteBufferParser() -> feedInput(...) + nextToken() with an unsigned integer that stops exactly at the chunk end
same two factory methods + feedInput(...), negative number ('-' then digits) split at the chunk end
same two factory methods with JsonReadFeature.ALLOW_LEADING_PLUS_SIGN_FOR_NUMBERS enabled ('+' then digits)

same two factory methods when the parser resumes a number in MINOR_NUMBER_INTEGER_DIGITS (reached from _startNegativeNumber/_startPositiveNumber/_finishNumberLeadingZeroes/_finishNumberLeadingPosNegZeroes)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The synchronous parsers are a different implementation from the one the advisory names ('Async parser'), and they do call validateIntegerLength from resetInt()/resetFloat() when the value completes, so they look already covered.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: A number of exactly maxNumberLength digits must still parse, and for a signed or plus-prefixed value the sign must not be counted toward the limit (the fix uses outPtr, outPtr-1 and outPtr+negMod at different sites); a wrong offset, or a check that fires on the first suspension, rejects a legal value, and _intLength must stay correct because _setFractLength/_setExpLength later validate _intLength+len.

O6_input_shapes: unsigned integer digits with no terminator, all digits in one oversized chunk
negative integer ('-' prefix) accumulated over many chunks smaller than the limit
integer that enters _finishNumberIntegralPart from the leading-zero / zero-run transitions
chunk boundaries that fall mid-number across many suspension resumes, versus a single oversized chunk

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Synchronous byte-stream parser appends integer digits into TextBuffer segments and only validates at resetInt() when the number completes; a terminator-less digit stream grows the buffer, bounded only by maxStringLength via TextBuffer.finishCurrentSegment() at TextBuffer.java:1017, never by maxNumberLength
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Sync parser, not the async one in the advisory title; resetInt() (ParserBase.java:584-597) validates the length at completion, so it looks protected.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, package com.fasterxml.jackson.core.json (one package across from json.async)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: DataInput-backed parser reads digits byte by byte (readUnsignedByte) and appends via _textBuffer.finishCurrentSegment() with no length check until resetInt(); the same class was the forgotten twin for maxNameLength in #1602
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different transport and a different class from the non-blocking parser; the previous maxNumberLength fix (release notes #1555) is worded as async-only.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, package com.fasterxml.jackson.core.json (one package across from json.async)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Reader-based parser accumulates integer digits in int_loop with finishCurrentSegment() and validates only in resetInt(), so a character stream of digits with no terminator is buffered past maxNumberLength
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Char-based reader, a third implementation; the advisory is about UTF-8 async byte chunks and this path does validate at completion.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other file, package com.fasterxml.jackson.core.json (one package across from json.async)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The plus-sign entry sets _intLength = 1 directly on its first suspension instead of going through _setIntLength, so a byte-order/feature-gated copy of the same check could be planted there
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The three sign-variant loops were clearly copy-pasted, and this one already bypasses the validating helper on one exit, so a maintainer writing the sibling fix would plausibly do the same.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second accumulator inside the same class (_parseUnsignedNumber) beside the one in _parseSignedNumber
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: This repository already shipped a fix (#1602, release-notes/VERSION-2.x:24-26) whose whole subject was that this class was missed when the limit was added elsewhere.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Counting coalesced leading zeroes toward maxNumberLength in _finishNumberLeadingPosNegZeroes
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: An over-hardening author reading 'chunked digit accumulation' would treat the zero-run loop as the same sink, even though those zeroes are discarded and never buffered.

O9_family: CWE-770 allocation without limits: unbounded number-text accumulation in the non-blocking parser (resource exhaustion / DoS)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Add _setIntLength(outPtr) only to the digit-first positive suspension in _startPositiveNumber, reproduce with one oversized chunk, and stop once the async byte-array test throws.
